description.value: A retrospective multimodal neuroimaging study comparing grey matter density and FDG PET metabolism in predementia patients with late-onset probable bvFTD and healthy controls, including disinhibited and apathetic subgroups.

spans.text: In this multi-modal imaging study we demonstrated significant GM atrophy and hypometabolism in a group of patients with late-onset bvFTD in the predementia stage.

description.value: Retrospective, observational, cross-sectional neuroimaging study with healthy controls; MRI and FDG PET were performed during the predementia stage and patients were followed clinically until probable bvFTD developed.

description.value: Modified optimized voxel-based morphometric preprocessing of structural MRI images.

spans.text: Images were preprocessed with SPM, using a modified optimized voxel-based morphometric technique [26].
SPM

First, a customized sample-specific whole-brain template was computed, and an a priori map for grey matter (GM), white matter and cerebrospinal fluid were determined by segmenting the sample-specific whole-brain template into the three components based on image intensity classification and probability of tissue class membership.
The segmented, normalized images were finally smoothed with an 8-mm full-width at half-maximum gaussian kernel

description.value: Affine and nonlinear spatial normalization of FDG PET images followed by Gaussian smoothing.
